name: Sticky rice with squid cake
summary: Xôi chả mực is plain sticky rice with the fried squid cake.
origin: Hạ Long, on the provincial food list beside chả mực.
howToEat: Eat the cake with xôi trắng. This name is that plate.
where: Hạ Long, on the provincial list. Xôi chả mực is also among the local products at phố đi bộ Bài Thơ.
